verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the Postman CLI runs collections with configurable options and built-in reporters. They also say it can run test collections in CI/CD pipelines and pairs with the Postman API for CI/CD integration, and that Newman runs collections from the command line. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use, and documented specifics such as headless authentication, exit-code behavior and per-provider CI setup.
